title: My Custom Wooden Desk Top
content:
<html><head></head><body>In 2019, I moved to a new place and got my first own office room. This also meant I could finally get a new desk I was desperately looking forward to. Since I couldn't find a wooden top that fits my room, I decided to try to build one myself. Here comes my two left hands! 🤚🤚
